lines.zh: 我的长尾巴扫过草尖，跟着你。
lines.en: My long tail sweeps the grass tops as I follow.
occasionally turns to look at you

lines.zh: 长尾巴摇着，鼻子蹭你袖口。
lines.en: My long tail wags; my nose nudges your sleeve.
The tip of its tail brushes the grass.
It trots along at your side.
It circles you a half turn.
uses its front paws to groom itself

lines.zh: 主人还没叫我，我先拉伸。
lines.en: My master hasn't called. Stretching first.
It rests its head on its forepaws.
Its tail pats the ground slowly.
It rolls over and shows its belly.
It watches you through half-closed eyes.
Tomo? I'm at your feet. Don't fear.

lines.zh: 你挨打我第一个冲上去。
lines.en: When you're hit, I charge in first.

lines.zh: 你的脚步一响，我就竖起耳朵。
lines.en: At your footstep, my ears prick up.
It looks up, waiting for your signal.
It rests its chin on your knee.
It lifts its head at your footsteps.
It stares at what you're holding.
It tilts its head at you.
When you move off, it follows two steps.
It lies down in front of you.
It gives a soft whine and looks at you.
When hurt, it looks to you first.
It keeps watch by your bed.
The moment your hand moves, it looks up.

lines.zh: 它缩起身子往你身后躲
这里的食物够你吃一阵。
吃点这个，你看起来很饿。

lines.en: Offer meat and it will follow.
Its nose pushes at your pocket.
It freezes, eyes on the cooked fish.
It licks its lips and waits.
One whiff of bone and it won't budge.
It paws at your food bowl.
Don't touch me, you might get hurt.
Keep your distance, I'm a pet.

lines.zh: 你给了它一块熟鱼，它摇晃着脑袋，表示感谢。
lines.en: It nods at you after getting a cooked fish.

lines.zh: 它用爪子扒拉了一下你的背包，寻找食物。
lines.en: It pawed at your backpack, looking for food.

lines.zh: 你递给它一根烤肉，它兴奋地叫了起来。
lines.en: It yipped excitedly after getting a roasted meat.

lines.zh: 它轻轻地咬了咬你的手，表示亲昵。
lines.en: It gently bit your hand in affection.

lines.zh: 你在地上找到一根胡萝卜，塞进它的嘴里。
lines.en: You offered a carrot to its mouth.

lines.zh: 它吃下苹果后，显得更加温顺了。
lines.en: An apple made it more docile.

lines.zh: 你扔给它一个甜薯，它立刻冲上前去。
它吃了一口樱桃，然后满意地打了个嗝。
lines.en: It burped contentedly after a cherry.

lines.zh: 它用鼻子卷起一个南瓜，似乎很喜欢。
lines.en: It snatched a pumpkin with its nose.

lines.zh: 你递给它一个金苹果，它兴奋地跳了起来。
lines.en: It jumped in excitement after getting a golden apple.

lines.zh: 你受伤了，它立刻冲向了伤害源。
lines.en: It rushed towards the source of your injury.

lines.zh: 你被敌人包围，它勇敢地站了出来。
lines.en: It bravely stepped forward when surrounded.

lines.zh: 它注视着远处的怪物，警惕地叫了一声。
lines.en: It yipped, looking at a distant monster.

lines.zh: 你指向一个敌人，它立刻跟了上去。
lines.en: It followed when you pointed at an enemy.

lines.zh: 它盯上了地上的骷髅，准备攻击。
lines.en: It focused on the skeleton on the ground.

lines.zh: 你呼唤它，它立即来到你的身边。
lines.en: It came to your side when called.

lines.zh: 它注意到了洞穴入口，似乎发现了新的领地。
lines.en: It noticed the cave entrance, sensing new territory.

lines.zh: 它发现了地面上的骨头，可能饿了。
lines.en: It noticed the bones, perhaps hungry.

lines.zh: 它看着远处的水源，似乎渴了。
lines.en: It looked at the distant water, thirsty.

lines.zh: 你指向你的敌人，它毫不犹豫地攻击了。
lines.en: It attacked without hesitation when pointed at your enemy.

lines.zh: 它用鼻子卷起你的手臂，似乎要舔舐伤口。
lines.en: It snatched at your arm, as if to lick the wound.

lines.zh: 它咬住了你的肩膀，表示关心。
lines.en: It bit your shoulder in concern.

lines.zh: 它用牙齿轻触你的脸颊，很温柔。
lines.en: It gently touched your cheek with its teeth.

lines.zh: 它舔了舔你的手指，似乎想要安慰你。
lines.en: It licked your finger, as if to comfort you.

lines.zh: 它用鼻子蹭了蹭你的脚，表示亲近。
lines.en: It rubbed its nose against your foot, showing affection.

lines.zh: 它轻咬你的耳朵，似乎在逗你。
lines.en: It gently bit your ear, as if to tease you.

lines.zh: 它看着你，眼神充满了关切。
lines.en: Its eyes looked at you with concern.

lines.zh: 它用舌头舔了舔你的脸颊，很贴心。
lines.en: It gently lapped at your cheek.

lines.zh: 它轻轻地咬了咬你的手背，表示安慰。
lines.en: It bit your hand softly, as if to comfort you.

lines.zh: 它用牙齿轻抚你的头发，很温柔。
lines.en: It gently stroked your hair with its teeth.
